body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 1. In deliberate lying, there is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring confession).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.2. omṛṣyavāde pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 2. In abusive speech, there is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.3. bhikṣupiśunye pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 3. In slandering a <s>bhikṣu</s>, there is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.4. yo punabhikṣū jānaṃ saṃghasyāghokaraṇāni / dharmmeṇa vinayena vihitāni vyupaśāntāni punaḥ karmmāya ukhoṭeya idaṃ punaḥ karmmakarttavyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti etadeva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā ananyamimantasya bhikṣūsya ukhoṭanaṃ pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 4. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowing that legal proceedings of the <s>Saṃgha</s> — conducted in accordance with <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> — have been settled and pacified, should dig them up again for re-adjudication [saying]: 'This case must be dealt with again!' — making this alone the reason and no other — the digging up by this <s>bhikṣu</s> is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.5. yo punabhikṣurakalpiyakāro mātṛgrāmasya dharmadeśeya uttaricchahi pañcāhi vācāhi anyatra vijñapuruṣa pudgalena pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 5. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, acting improperly, should teach <s>Dharma</s> to a woman exceeding five sentences — unless in the presence of a knowledgeable man — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.6. yo punabhikṣūranupasaṃpannaṃ pudgalaṃ padaśo dharmmavāceya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 6. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should teach <s>Dharma</s> word by word to an unordained person — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.7. yo punabhikṣuranupasaṃpannasya pudgalasya santike ātmopanāyikamuttarimanuṣyadharmmamalamāryajñānadalanaṃ dviśeṣādhigamampratijāneya iti jānāmi iti paśyāmīti bhūmi tasmiṃ pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 7. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, in the presence of an unordained person, should claim for himself a superhuman attainment (<s>uttarimanuṣyadharma</s>) — a noble knowledge and vision, a distinctive achievement — [saying] 'Thus I know, thus I see' — if it is true — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.8. yo punabhikṣūrjjānan bhikṣūsya dūthūllāmāpattimanupasaṃpannasya pudgalasya santike āroceya anyatra kṛtaye prakāśanāsammutīye pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 8. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should report a <s>bhikṣu's</s> grave offense to an unordained person — except with the authorization of a formal act of disclosure — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.9. yo punabhikṣurjñānasāṃdhike lābhe bhājīyamāne pūrvve samanujo bhūtvā paścātkhiyā dharmmamāpadyeya yathāsaṃstutamevāyuṣmanto yānaṃ sāṃdhikaṃ lābhaṃ saṃghe pariṇataṃ pudgalo pudgalasya pariṇāmayatīti pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 9. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, when communal gains are being distributed, having first given consent, should afterwards raise a complaint [saying]: 'The venerable ones are diverting communal gains designated for the <s>Saṃgha</s> — a person is diverting [them] to a [specific] person, just as agreed!' — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.10. yo punabhikṣūranvarddhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddiśyamāne evaṃ vadeya kiṃ punarāyuṣmanto ime hi kṣudrāśca kṣūdre hi śikṣāpade hi uddiṣte hi yāvadeva bhikṣuṇāṃ kaukṛtyāya vighātāya vilekhāya saṃvarttatīti śikṣāvigarhaṇapācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 10. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, when the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> sūtra is being recited every half-month, should speak thus: 'Why, venerable ones, are these petty training rules recited? When these petty training rules are recited, they only lead to remorse, vexation, and confusion for the <s>bhikṣus</s>' — the disparaging of the training is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.uddānam / [1] mṛṣā [2] omṛṣya [3] peśunya [4] ukhoṭana [5] dharmmedeśanā [6] padaśo [7] viśeṣaṇa [8] mārocanā [9] yathāsaṃstuta [10] vigarhaṇena / prathamo vaggaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [1] lying, [2] abusive speech, [3] slander, [4] digging up [settled cases], [5] teaching <s>Dharma</s> [to women], [6] word by word [teaching], [7] claiming distinction, [8] reporting [offenses], [9] according to agreement, [10] disparaging — this is the first section.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.11. bījagrāmabhūtagrāma pātāpanake pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 11. In destroying seed-life or plant-life, there is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.12. anyavāda vihiṃsanake pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 12. In evasion and causing annoyance, there is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.13. odhyāyana kṣīyanake pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 13. In complaining and criticizing, there is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.14. yo punabhikṣūḥ sāṃdhike bhikṣuvihāre adyavakāśe mañcamvā pīṭhamvā viśikaraṃmvā caturagrakaṃ vā kuccamvā bimbohanamvā prajñāyeyatvā vā / prajñāyāyatvā vā tato prakramanto na udvareya vā na udvarāyeya vā anāmantrayitvā vā prakrameya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 14. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a communal <s>bhikṣu</s>-dwelling, in the open space, should set out a bed, a seat, a bench, a four-legged stool, a cushion, or a pillow — having set it out or having had it set out — on departing therefrom, should not put it away or have it put away, or should depart without informing [anyone] — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.15. yo punabhikṣūḥ sāṃdhike bhikṣuvihāre antośayyāṃ prajñāyetvā prajñayāyetvā [vā] / tato prakramanto na udvareya vā na udvarāyeya vā anāmantrayitvā vā prakrameya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 15. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a communal <s>bhikṣu</s>-dwelling, should lay out a sleeping place — having laid it out or having had it laid out — on departing therefrom, should not put it away or have it put away, or should depart without informing [anyone] — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.16. yo punabhikṣū bhikṣūsya duṣto duṣānkupito anāttamano sāṃdhikā bhikṣuvihārā bhikṣūnnikaḍheya vā nikaḍhḍhāyea vā antamasato nihi bhikṣūti vā vādeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 16. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, being corrupt, angry from hostility, displeased, should push out or have pushed out a <s>bhikṣu</s> from a communal <s>bhikṣu</s>-dwelling, or should say even [so much as]: 'Get out, <s>bhikṣu</s>!' — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.17. yo punabhikṣu sāṃdhike bhikṣūvihāre jānanbhikṣūṇāṃ pūrvvaprajñaptā hi śayyāṃ hi paścādagatvā madhye śayyāṃ prajñāyeya yasyodvahiṣyati so prakramiṣyatīti etadeva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā ananyamimaṃ tasya bhikṣūsya udvāhana pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 17. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a communal <s>bhikṣu</s>-dwelling, knowing that sleeping places have been previously assigned to <s>bhikṣus</s>, should come later and lay out a sleeping place in the middle [thinking]: 'Whoever is uncomfortable will leave' — making this alone the reason and no other — this disturbance of that <s>bhikṣu</s> is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.18. yo punabhikṣūḥ sāṃdhike bhikṣūvihāropari vaihāyasaṃ kuṭikāye āhatya pādake maṃce vā pīṭhe vā abhiniṣīdeya vā abhinipadyeya vā pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 18. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a communal <s>bhikṣu</s>-dwelling, on the upper floor of an open-air hut, should sit down or lie down on a bed or seat with detachable legs [that are fitted with] hammered-in pegs — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.19. yo punabhikṣūjjānansaprāṇakenodakena tṛṇaṃ vā mṛttikāṃ vā siṃceya vā siṃcāyeya vā pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 19. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should sprinkle or have sprinkled grass or clay with water containing living beings — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.20. mahallakaṃ bhikṣuṇā vihāraṃ chādāpayamānena yāvadvārakoṣā agalapratiṣṭhāna mālokasandhiparikarmmamupādāya dve vā trayo vā cchādanaparyāyā adhiṣṭhihitavyāḥ / alpaharite sthitena taduttariṃ adhiṣṭhiheya alpaharite sthitopi pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 20. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a large <s>vihāra</s> roofed, starting from the door-frame, the bolt-socket, and the finishing around the window-openings, he should oversee two or three layers of roofing. If, standing on bare ground, he should oversee more than that — even while standing on bare ground — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.uddānaṃ [11] bījaṃ [12] anyavādaṃ [13] udhyāyanaṃ [14] mañca [15] sayyā [16] nikaṭṭanaṃ [17] pūrvvopagataṃ [18] vaihāyasaṃ [19] udaka [20] cchādanena // dvitīyovagaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [11] seed, [12] evasion, [13] criticism, [14] bed, [15] bedding, [16] annoyance, [17] arriving earlier, [18] in the open air, [19] water, [20] with roofing. Second section.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.21. yo punabhikṣū asammato bhikṣuṇīmovadeya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 21. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, being unappointed, should instruct a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.22. sammatovāpi bhikṣūḥ bhikṣūṇīmovadeya vikāle astaṃgate sūye anūhate aruṇe pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 22. Even if a <s>bhikṣu</s> has been appointed, should he instruct a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> at an improper time — after the sun has set [and] before dawn has risen — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.23. yo punabhikṣū ovādaprekṣo bhikṣuṇī upāśrayamupasaṃkrāmeya santaṃ bhikṣūmanāmantrayitvā anyatra samaye pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 23. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, who has the role of instructor, should approach the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' dwelling without notifying an existing <s>bhikṣu</s>, except at the proper time, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: tatrāyaṃ samayo gilānābhikṣuṇī ovaditavyāḥ anuśāsitavyāḥ bhavati ayamatrasamayo //
body.translated_text: Herein, the proper time is this: when a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is ill, she is to be instructed and admonished — this is the proper time herein.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.24. yo punabhikṣū bhikṣumaivaṃ vadeya āmiṣaheto āyuṣmanbhikṣū bhikṣūṇīṃ ovadatīti pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 24. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should say to a <s>bhikṣu</s>: 'Venerable one, this <s>bhikṣu</s> instructs <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for the sake of material gain' — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.25. yo punabhikṣū bhikṣūṇīya sārdhameko ekāeraho niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 25. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should arrange to sit alone with a single <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.26. yo punabhikṣū bhikṣūṇīyasārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya adhvānamāgaṃ pratipadyeya antamasato grāmāntaraṃ pi anyatrasamaye pācattikam // tatrāyaṃ samayo māgo bhavati / sabhayo sapratibhayo sāsaṃkasammaṃto ayamatra samayo /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 26. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, having made an arrangement with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, should set out on a road journey, even if only to the next village, except at the proper time — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Herein, the proper time is this: when the road is dangerous, frightening, or considered suspect — this is the proper time herein.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.27. yo punabhikṣu bhikṣuṇīyasārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvāṃ abhiruheya urddhagāminīmvā adhogāminīmvā anyatra tiryāttaraṇāya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 27. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, having made an arrangement with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, should board the same boat, whether going upstream or downstream, except for crossing to the other side — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.28. yo punabhikṣū anyātikāye bhikṣuṇīye cīvaraṃ dadyādanyatra patuntakena pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 28. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should give a robe to a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative, except in exchange — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.29. yo punabhikṣuranyātikāye bhikṣuṇīye cīvaraṃ sīveya vā sīvāyeya vā pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 29. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should sew or have [a robe] sewn for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.30. yo punabhikṣūrjānanbhikṣuṇī paripācitaṃ pinḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjeya anyatra pūrvvegṛhī samārambhe pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 30. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should consume almsfood prepared [specifically for him] by a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, except when there has been a prior invitation from a householder — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: udyānaṃ // [21] asammato [22] sammatorapi [23] ovādo [24] āmiṣaṃ [25] niṣadyāca [26] adhvānamārgo [27] nāvā ca [28] deti / [29] sīveti [30] paripācanena // tṛtīyo vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [21] unappointed, [22] even if appointed, [23] instruction, [24] material gain, [25] and sitting, [26] road journey, [27] and boat, [28] gives, [29] sews, [30] with preparation [of food]. Third section.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.31. ekāhaparamaṃ bhikṣuṇā agilānena avasathapinḍapātro paribhuṃñjitavyā taduttariṃ paribhuṃjye pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 31. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who is not ill may partake of food at a public alms-hall for one day at most. If he partakes beyond that — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.32. paramparābhojane anyatra samaye pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 32. Eating in succession [at more than one place], except at the proper time — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: tatrāyaṃ samayo / gilānasamayo cīvaradānakālasamayo ayamatra samayo /
body.translated_text: Herein, the proper time is this: a time of illness, a time of robe-giving — this is the proper time herein.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.33. yo punabhikṣurbhuñjāvīpravārito utthito āsanāto anatiriktaṃ kṛtaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeya vā bhuṃñjeya vā pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 33. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, having eaten, being one who has been satisfied, having risen from his seat, should chew or eat food — whether hard or soft — that has not been designated as extra, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.34. yo punabhikṣujānanbhikṣū bhuktāvipravāritamutthitamāsanāto āsādanāprekṣo anatiriktakṛtena khādanīyena vā bhojanīyena vā upanimantreya ehi bhikṣu khādārhaṃ bhuṃjāhīti vā vadeya bhuktasmiṃ pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 34. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowing that a <s>bhikṣu</s> has eaten, has been satisfied, and has risen from his seat, should invite him with the intent to entrap [him] with food — whether hard or soft — that has not been designated as extra, saying 'Come, <s>bhikṣu</s>, eat what is suitable!' — when [the other] has eaten, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.35. yo punabhikṣūradinnamapratigrāhitaṃ mukhadvārikamāhāramāhāreya anyatrodaka dantapoṇe pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 35. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should consume food that has not been given and not received, [putting it] into his mouth — except water and tooth-cleanser — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.36. vikālābhojane pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 36. Eating at the wrong time — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.37. sannidhekāra bhojane pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 37. Eating food that has been stored — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.38. bhikṣuṃ kho punaḥ kūle hi upasaṃkrāntaṃ pravāretsupūvehi vā manthe hi vā tathā pravāritena bhikṣuṇā yāvantripātrapūraparamaṃ tato pratigṛhṇitavyaṃ / pratigṛhṇitvā vahirdvānīharitavyaṃ vahirdvānīharitvā agilānake hi bhikṣū hi sārdhaṃ samvibhajitvā khāditavyaṃ bhuṃjitavyaṃ taduttariṃ pratigṛhṇitvā vahirdvānīharitvā agilānake hi bhikṣū hi sārddhaṃ samvibhajitvā vā asaṃvibhajitvā vā khādeva vā bhuṃjeya vā pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 38. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has approached families is offered cakes or confections, the <s>bhikṣu</s> who has thus been offered should accept at most enough to fill two or three bowls. Having accepted [that much], he should take it outside; having taken it outside, he should share it with <s>bhikṣus</s> who are not ill and then eat. If, after accepting more than that, having taken it outside, whether or not having shared it with <s>bhikṣus</s> who are not ill, he should eat — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.39. yāni kho punarimāni praṇītasammatāni bhojanāni bhavanti saṃyyathīdaṃ sarpistilaṃ madhuphāṇitaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi matsyaṃ māsaṃ yo punabhikṣūrevaṃ rūpāṇi praṇītasammatāni bhojanāni ātmātvāya agilāno kūle hi vijñepetvā vā vijñāpayetvā vā khādeya vā bhuṃjeya pācattiṃkam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 39. There are these foods considered choice — namely, ghee, sesame oil, honey, molasses, milk, curds, fish, and meat. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, being not ill, having requested or caused to be requested such choice foods from families for his own sake, should eat — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.40. gaṇabhojane anyatrasamaye pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 40. Eating in a group, except at the proper time — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: tatrāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo cīvaradānakālasamayo adhvānagamanasamayo nāvābhirohaṇasamayo mahāsamayo śravaṇabhuktaṃ ayamatrasamayo /
body.translated_text: Herein, the proper time is this: a time of illness, a time of robe-giving, a time of traveling, a time of boarding a boat, a great assembly, a meal offered by <s>śramaṇas</s> — this is the proper time herein.

body.text: udyānaṃ / [31] āvasatho [32] paramparā [33] pravāraṇā [34] āsadanā [35] adinnaṃ [36] vikālaṃ [37] saṃnidhiṃ [38] manthāṃ [39] vijñaptiḥ [40] gaṇabhojanena // caturtho vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [31] alms-hall, [32] successive [meals], [33] refusal [and eating again], [34] entrapment, [35] what is not given, [36] wrong time, [37] stored [food], [38] confections, [39] requesting, [40] with group eating. Fourth section.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.41. yo punarbhikṣurātmārthāya agilāno kṣobhisminvitāpanā prokto / tṛṇaṃ vā kāṣṭhaṃ vā gomayaṃ vā sakalikāṃvā oṣamvā saṃkāramvā ādapaheya vā ādahāyeya vā anyatra samaye pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 41. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, for his own sake, not being ill — regarding this, there is a stipulation — should kindle or have kindled grass, wood, cow-dung, bark, herbs, or refuse, except at the proper time — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.42. yo punarbhikṣuranupasaṃpannena pudgalena sārddhaṃ uttari dvirātraṃ trirātraṃ vā sahagāraśayyāṃ kalpeya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 42. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should arrange to sleep under the same roof with a person who has not received full ordination for more than two or three nights — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.43. yo punarbhikṣurbhikṣūṇāṃ karmaṇācchandandatvā paścādduṣṭo doṣānkupito anāttamano evaṃ vadeya adinnaṃ me cchando durddinno me cchando akṛtānyetāni karmāṇi duṣkṛtānyetāni karmāṇi nāhame teṣāṃ karmaṇācchandaṃ demīti vadeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 43. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, having given his consent to the <s>bhikṣus</s>' formal act, afterward, being corrupt, hostile, angry, and displeased, should speak thus: 'My consent was not given! My consent was wrongly given! These acts are not [properly] done! These acts are poorly done! I do not give my consent to those acts!' — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.44. yo punabhikṣū bhikṣūmevaṃ vadeya ehi tvaṃ māyuṣmāngrāmaṃ pinḍāya praviśiṣyāmaḥ / ahañca te tatra kiñcidāpayiṣyaṃ / so tatra tasya kiñcidāpayitvā vā adāpayitvā vā paścādudyojanaṃ prakṣo evaṃ vadeya gaccha tvamāyuṣmanname tvayā sārdhaṃ phāsu bhavati kathāya vā niṣadyāya vā / ekasyai ca mama phāsu bhavati / kathāya vā niṣadyāya vā etadeva pratyeyaṃ kṛtvā ananyamimantasya bhikṣusya udyojana pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 44. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should say to a <s>bhikṣu</s>: 'Come, venerable one, let us enter the village for alms. I shall provide you with something there.' If he, whether having provided or not having provided that person with something there, afterward, with the intent to dismiss him, should say thus: 'Go, venerable one, I am not comfortable in your company, whether for conversation or for sitting. I am comfortable alone, whether for conversation or for sitting.' If, doing this for that very reason alone and for no other, he should dismiss that <s>bhikṣu</s> — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.45. yo punabhikṣu bhikṣūnevaṃ vadeya tathāhamāyuṣmānto bhagavatā dharmmandeśitamājānāmi yathā ye ime antarāyikā dharmā uktā bhagavatā tānpratisevato vā nālamantarāyāya / so bhikṣū bhikṣū hi evamasya vacanīyo mā āyuṣmannevamvada mā bhagavantam ācakṣa / asatā buddhyāhī tena antarāyikā evamāyuṣma ndharmāḥ samānā antarāyikā dharmā uktā bhagavatā alañca punastān pratisevato antarāyāya / evaṃ ca so bhikṣu bhikṣuhi vucyamāno taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareya ityetaṃ kuśalānno ca pratinissareya / so bhikṣu bhikṣuhi yāvantṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyo samanubhāṣitavyo tasya vastusya pratinissagāya yāvantṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇo vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇo vā taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareya ityetaṃ kuśalaṃ no ca pratiniḥsareya so bhikṣūḥ samagreṇa saṃghena ukṣipitavyo imaṃ tasya bhikṣusya ukṣepaṇa pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 45. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should say to the <s>bhikṣus</s>: 'Venerable ones, I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the <s>Bhagavān</s> in such a way that those things declared by the <s>Bhagavān</s> to be obstructive are not sufficient to cause obstruction for one who practices them' — that <s>bhikṣu</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'Venerable one, do not say so! Do not misrepresent the <s>Bhagavān</s>! For it is not good to misrepresent the <s>Bhagavān</s>; those things, venerable one, that are obstructive are declared by the <s>Bhagavān</s> to be obstructive; and they are indeed sufficient to cause obstruction for one who practices them.' If that <s>bhikṣu</s>, being thus addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s>, should relinquish that matter — that is good. If he does not relinquish — that <s>bhikṣu</s> should be admonished and exhorted up to three times by the <s>bhikṣus</s> for the relinquishing of that matter. If, being admonished and exhorted up to three times, he relinquishes that matter — that is good. If he does not relinquish — that <s>bhikṣu</s> should be suspended by the united <s>Saṃgha</s>. This suspension of that <s>bhikṣu</s> is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.46. yo puna bhikṣurjānanbhikṣu tathā ukṣiptaṃ samagreṇa saṃghena dharmeṇa vinayena yathāvādiṃ tathā kāritāṃ pāpikāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ apratinissaraṇaṃ taṃ akṛtānudharmmaṃ sabhuṃjeya vā saṃvaseya vā sahagāraśayyāmvā kalpeya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 46. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should eat with, live with, or arrange to sleep under the same roof with a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has been thus suspended by the united <s>Saṃgha</s>, in accordance with <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> — one who acts as he speaks, who holds a wicked view and has not relinquished it, who has not performed the acts in accordance with the rule — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.47. śramaṇuddeśopi cedevaṃ vadeyaṃ ta thāhamāyuṣmānto bhagavatā dharmadeśitamājānāmi yathā ye ime antarāyikā kāmā uktā bhagavatā tānpratisevato nālamantarāyāya so śramaṇuddeśo bhikṣūhi evamasya vacanīyo mā āyuṣman śramaṇuddeśa evamvada mā bhagavantamasyācakṣa asatādudgṛhītena antarāyikā evāyuṣmanśramaṇuddeśakāmāḥ / samānā antarāyikāḥ kāmā uktā bhagavatā alaṃ ca punastānpratisevato antarāyāya / evañca so śramaṇuddeśo bhikṣū hi vucyamāno taṃ vastu pratiniḥsareya ityetaṃ kuśalanno ca pratinissareyasto śramaṇuddeśo bhikṣūhi yāvantṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyo samanubhāṣitavyo tasya vastusya pratiniḥssagāya yāvantṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇo vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇo vā taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ityetaṃ kuśalanno ca pratiniḥsareyaḥ so śramaṇuddeśo bhikṣū hi nāśayitavyo adyadagreṇa te āyuṣman śramaṇuddeśa na caiva so bhagavānastathāgato(?)rhansamyak saṃbuddhe śāstāvyapadiśitavyo yaṃ pi ca dāni labhasi bhikṣūrhi sārdhaṃ dvirātraṃ vā trirātramvā sahagāraśayyāṃ sāyite adyadagreṇa nāsti gacchanasya cala prapalāhi / yo punabhikṣū jānantathārmaśitaṃ śramaṇuddeśaṃ yathāvādīntathā kāritāṃ pāpikāṃ dṛṣṭimapratiniḥsarantaṃ akṛtānudharmma upasthāye vā upalāyeya vā saṃbhuṃjeya vā saṃvaseya vā sahagāraśayyāṃ vā kalpeya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.47. If a novice (<s>śramaṇuddeśa</s>) should say thus: 'As I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the Blessed One, the sensual pleasures that the Blessed One has called obstructive are not sufficient to obstruct one who indulges in them' — that novice should be spoken to by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'Do not say so, venerable novice. Do not misrepresent the Blessed One with a false interpretation. The sensual pleasures, venerable novice, are indeed obstructive. The sensual pleasures have been called obstructive by the Blessed One, and they are indeed sufficient to obstruct one who indulges in them.' If that novice, being spoken to thus by the <s>bhikṣus</s>, should abandon that view — that is good. If he does not abandon it, that novice should be admonished and instructed by the <s>bhikṣus</s> up to three times for the abandonment of that view. If, being admonished and instructed up to three times, he abandons that view — that is good. If he does not abandon it, that novice should be expelled by the <s>bhikṣus</s>: 'From this day forward, venerable novice, that Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Enlightened One, is not to be claimed by you as your teacher. And whatever you now obtain — sharing a sleeping place with <s>bhikṣus</s> for two or three nights — from this day forward, that is not [permitted]. Go away, depart, leave!' If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly serves, attends upon, eats with, dwells with, or shares a sleeping place with a novice who has been so expelled and who, speaking thus, has been made to act accordingly, holding a wicked view and not having abandoned it, without having performed the proper procedure — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.48. navacīvaralābhinā bhikṣuṇā trayāṇāmduvarṇīkaraṇānāmanyatarānyataraṃ durvvaṇṇīkaraṇasādayitavyaṃ / nīlamvā kardamamvā kālaśyāmanvā tato ca bhikṣūranādāya navaṃ cīvaraparibhuṃjeya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.48. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who has obtained a new robe must apply one of the three means of disfiguring: blue, mud-color, or dark brown. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, without having applied [a disfiguring mark], wears a new robe, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.49. yo punarbhikṣūranyatra adhyārāme vā adhyāvasathe vā / ratanamvā ratanasaṃmatamvā udgṛhṇāya vā udgṛhṇāyeya vā pācattikam / ākāṃkṣamāṇena bhikṣuṇā ratanamvā ratanasammatamvā / adhyārāme vā adhyāvasathe vā udgṛhṇītavyaṃ vā udgṛhṇāyayitavyaṃ vā yasya bhaviṣyati so hariṣyatīti etadevapratyayaṃ kṛtvā ananyamiyamatrasāmīcī /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.49. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, except within a monastery or a dwelling, picks up or has [another] pick up a jewel or what is considered a jewel, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation). If a <s>bhikṣu</s> wishes, he may pick up or have [another] pick up a jewel or what is considered a jewel within a monastery or a dwelling, [thinking]: 'Whoever it belongs to will take it' — having made just this intention and no other. This is the proper procedure herein.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.50. anvarddhamāsaṃ snānamuktaṃ bhagavatā anyatrasamaye pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.50. Bathing once a fortnight has been prescribed by the Blessed One, except at the proper time. [Otherwise] it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: tatrāyaṃ samayo dvyarddho māso śeṣe grīṣmāṇāmvarṣāṇāṃ ca purimo māso ityete ardhātīya māsaḥ paridāhakālasamayo adhvānagamanakālasamayo gilānasamayo karmasamayo vātasamayo vṛṣṭisamayo ayamatrasamayoḥ /
body.translated_text: Herein, this is the proper time: the last half-month of summer and the first month of the rains — these are the two and a half months. The proper time [includes]: the time of intense heat, the time of traveling on a journey, the time of illness, the time of work, the time of wind, the time of rain. This is the proper time herein.

body.text: udyānam // [41] kṣobhiḥ [42] sahagāra [43] cchandam [44] udyojanā [45-46-47] trayo'ntarāyikā [48] akṛtakalpam [49] ratanaṃ [50] snānena // pañcamo vaggaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse: [41] agitation, [42] sharing a room, [43] consent, [44] instigation, [45-46-47] three [rules on] obstructive [pleasures], [48] without disfiguring, [49] a jewel, [50] by bathing. Fifth section.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.51. yo punabhikṣu jānia prāṇakamudakaṃ paribhuṃjeya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.51. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly uses water containing living creatures, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.52. yo punabhikṣū avelaka sya vā avelikāya vā parivrājakasya vā parivrājakāye vā svahastaṃ khādanīyamvā bhojanīyamvā dadyātpācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.52. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> gives food — whether hard or soft — with his own hand to a male or female <s>Ājīvaka</s> or to a male or female wandering ascetic (<s>parivrājaka</s>), it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.53. yo punabhikṣū jānantaṃ bhojanīye kule anupakhajjāsane niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.53. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly sits down intruding upon a family that is at their meal, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.54. yo punabhikṣu jania bhojanīye kule praticchannāsane niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.54. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly sits down at a screened seat in a family that is at their meal, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.55. yo punabhikṣurudyaktāṃ se nāmdarśanāya gaccheya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.55. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> goes to see an army drawn up [for battle], it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.56. syāttasya bhikṣusya kvacideva pratyayosanāyāṅgamanāya dvi[rā] tramvā trirātramvā tena bhikṣuṇāsenāyāṃ vasitavyaṃ taducarīṃ vaseya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.56. If there is some reason for that <s>bhikṣu</s> to go to an army, that <s>bhikṣu</s> may stay with the army for two or three nights. If he stays beyond that, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.57. tatrāpi ca bhikṣu dvirātramvā trirātramvā senāyāṃ vasamāno āyūhikamvā niyūhikaṃmvā aneka vyūhamvā dhvajāmvā śīrṣamvā darśanāya gaccheya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.57. Moreover, if that <s>bhikṣu</s>, while staying two or three nights with the army, goes to see the battle array, the counter-array, the troops in various formations, the banners, or the leading troops, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.58. yo punabhikṣu bhikṣuṃ prahareya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.58. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> strikes a <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.59. yo punabhikṣu bhikṣusya talaśaktikāmāvarjeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.59. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> raises the palm of his hand threateningly against a <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.60. yo punarbhikṣu jānan bhikṣūsya dusthūlāmāpattiṃ kṛtamavyācīṇṇāṃ cchādeya so na pareṣāmāroceya kinti semāpare jānanneti avadya praticchādane pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.60. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly conceals a serious offense committed and unconfessed by a <s>bhikṣu</s>, and does not report it to others — [thinking] 'May the others not come to know' — in concealing the fault, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: udyānaṃ // [51] saprāṇakam [52] avelako [53] anupakhajjaṃ / [54] pratichannāsanaṃ [55-56-57] senāyāṃ [58] praharati [59] talaśaktikā [60] praticchādanena // ṣaṣṭho vaggaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse: [51] containing living creatures, [52] <s>Ājīvaka</s>, [53] intruding, [54] a screened seat, [55-56-57] the army, [58] striking, [59] palm of the hand, [60] by concealing. Sixth section.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.61. yo punabhikṣu saṃcintya tiryagyonigataṃ prāṇinaṃ jīvitād vyaparopeya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.61. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> intentionally deprives of life a living being of the animal realm, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.62. yo punabhikṣu bhikṣusya saṃcintya kaukṛtyamupasaṃhareya kintisa muhūrttampi aphāsu bhavediti pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.62. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> intentionally causes remorse to a <s>bhikṣu</s> — [thinking] 'Thus he will be uncomfortable even for a moment' — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.63. yo punarbhikṣū bhikṣūsya vā bhikṣuṇīye vā śrāmaṇerasye vā śrāmaṇerīye vā śikṣamāṇāye vā cīvaramdatvā apratyuddhareya paribhuṃjeya apratyuddhāraparibhoge pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.63. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having given a robe to a <s>bhikṣu</s>, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, a <s>śrāmaṇera</s>, a <s>śrāmaṇerī</s>, or a <s>śikṣamāṇā</s>, takes it back [and] uses it without having taken it back [properly], in [such] use without proper retrieval, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.64. yo punarbhikṣū bhikṣūsya pātriṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā niṣīdanaṃ vā sūcīvigrahamvā apaniheyamvā apanihāyeya vā antamasato hāsyāñcāpi pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.64. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> hides or has [another] hide a <s>bhikṣu</s>'s bowl, robe, sitting mat, or needle case — even as a joke — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.65. yo punabhikṣū bhikṣūṃ bhīṣeya pācattikam
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.65. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> frightens a <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.66. udake hastasammardanāt pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.66. From playful splashing in water, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.67. aṅgalipracodanāt pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.67. From tickling with the finger, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.68. yo punabhikṣū mātṛgrāmeṇa sārddhaṃ saṃvidhāya adhvānamārgaṃ pratipadyet antamasato grāmāntaraṃ pi pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.68. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having made an arrangement, travels on a road together with a woman — even to the next village — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.69. yo punarbhikṣū mātṛgrāmeṇa sārddhaṃ sahagāraśayyāṃ kalpeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.69. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> shares a sleeping place under the same roof with a woman, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.70. yo punarbhikṣū mātṛgrāmeṇa sārddhaṃ eko ekāyaraho niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.70. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> sits alone with a woman in a secluded place, one man with one woman, it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: udyānam / [61] saṃcintya [62] kaukṛtya [63] mapratyuddharitya [64] kāpaniheya [65] bhiṣeya [66] udake [67] aṃgulī [68] saṃvidhāya [69] sahagāra [70] niṣadyāya // saptamo vaggaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse: [61] intentionally, [62] remorse, [63] without proper retrieval, [64] hiding, [65] frightening, [66] in water, [67] with the finger, [68] by arrangement, [69] sharing a room, [70] by sitting [alone]. Seventh section.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.71. yo punarbhikṣū jānantaṃ unaviṃśativarṣaṃ pudgalaṃ bhikṣu upasaṃpādeya so ca pudgalo anupasaṃpanno te ca bhikṣū gārhyāṃ imaṃstathā bhikṣuṇāgarhaṇaṃ pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.71. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly gives full ordination (<s>upasaṃpāda</s>) to a person who is under twenty years of age, that person is not ordained, and those <s>bhikṣus</s> are blameworthy. For that <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is a censure: a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.72. yo punarbhikṣū jānanstainyasārdhena sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya adhvānamārgaṃ pratipadyeya antamasato grāmāntaraṃ pi pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.72. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly having made an arrangement, travels on a road together with a caravan of thieves — even to the next village — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.73. yo punarbhikṣū svahastapṛthvīm khaneya vā khanāyeya vā antamasato iha khanehīti evaṃ vadeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.73. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> digs the earth with his own hand or has [another] dig it, or even says 'dig here' — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.74. cāturmāsikaṃ bhikṣuṇā pratyeka pravāraṇā sādayitavyā taduttariṃ sādiyeya anyatra punaḥ pravāraṇāye anyatra yāvajjīvikāye pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.74. A <s>bhikṣu</s> should accept individual invitation (<s>pravāraṇā</s>) [to a meal] for a maximum of four months. If he accepts beyond that — except for a renewed invitation or a lifelong invitation — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.75. yo punarbhikṣū bhikṣū hi evaṃ vucyamāno ime hi te āyuṣman pañca hi āpattikāye anadhyāvācāya śikṣā karaṇīyeti / so bhikṣū tāṃ bhikṣunevaṃ vadeya na yāvadahamāyuṣmantānāṃ vacanena śikṣiṣyaṃ yāvadahaṃ na drakṣyāmi svavirānbhikṣūn sūtradharān vinayadharān mātṛkādharān madhyamānbhikṣūn sūtradharānvinayadharān mātṛkādharān navakānbhikṣū sūtradharān vinayadharān mātṛkādharānnatāṃstāvadahamupasaṃkramya paripṛṣṭhiṣyaṃ paripraśnī kariṣyanti pācattikam // śikṣyakāmena bhikṣuṇā ājñātavyamupalakṣitavyamupadhārayitavyam //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.75. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, when <s>bhikṣus</s> address him thus: 'These, venerable one, are five offenses requiring non-concealment, in which you must undertake the training' — that <s>bhikṣu</s> says to those <s>bhikṣus</s>: 'I shall not train in accordance with the words of the venerable ones until I have seen elder <s>bhikṣus</s> who are holders of the <s>sūtras</s>, holders of the <s>Vinaya</s>, and holders of the <s>mātṛkā</s>; middle-ranking <s>bhikṣus</s> who are holders of the <s>sūtras</s>, holders of the <s>Vinaya</s>, and holders of the <s>mātṛkā</s>; and junior <s>bhikṣus</s> who are holders of the <s>sūtras</s>, holders of the <s>Vinaya</s>, and holders of the <s>mātṛkā</s> — until then I shall approach and question them, and they will make inquiry' — it is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation). A <s>bhikṣu</s> who desires to train should understand, mark, and retain [the rules].

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.76. surāmaireya madyapānaṃ pāpacattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> (<s>Mahāsāṃghika</s>) Pāc.76. Drinking liquor (<s>surā</s>), spirits (<s>maireya</s>), or intoxicants is a <s>pācattika</s> (offense requiring expiation).

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.77. bhikṣunādarye pācattikam /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 77. In disrespect toward a <s>bhikṣu</s>, there is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.78. yo punarbhikṣū bhikṣū hi kalahajāte hi bhanḍana jāte hi vigrahavivādāpanne hi viharante hi upaśrotrasthāne tiṣṭheya yaṃ ete vadiṣyanti taṃ śrutvā upasaṃhariṣyāmīti / etadeva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā ananyamimantasya bhikṣūsya upaśrotrasthāne pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 78. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, when <s>bhikṣus</s> are quarreling, disputing, engaged in conflict and controversy, should stand within earshot [thinking]: 'Whatever they say, I shall listen and take it up' — making this alone the reason and no other — standing within earshot of that <s>bhikṣu</s> is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.79. yo punabhikṣūḥ saṃghe viniścayakathā hi varttamānā hi utthāyāsanātprakrameya santaṃ bhikṣūmanāmantrayitvā anyatra tathārūpe atyāyike karaṇīye pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 79. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, when a matter of adjudication is being discussed in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, should rise from his seat and depart without informing an existing <s>bhikṣu</s> — except in a genuinely urgent matter — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.80. yo punabhikṣū āraṇyake śayyāsane viharanto vikāle grāmaṃ praviśeya santaṃ bhikṣūmanāmantrayitvā anyatra tathārūpe atyāyike karaṇīye pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 80. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, dwelling in a forest lodging, should enter a village at the wrong time without informing an existing <s>bhikṣu</s> — except in a genuinely urgent matter — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: uddānaṃ // [71] ūnaviṃśati [72] stainyasārdhaṃ [73] pṛthivī [74] pravāraṇā [75] na śikṣiṣyaṃ [76] madyapāna [77] manādaryaṃ [78] mupaśrotra [79] viniścaya [80] āraṇyakena // aṣṭamo vaggaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [71] under twenty, [72] ordaining a thief, [73] earth, [74] <s>pravāraṇā</s> (invitation), [75] 'I shall not train,' [76] liquor-drinking, [77] disrespect, [78] eavesdropping, [79] adjudication, [80] with the forest-dweller. Eighth section.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.81. yo puna bhikṣū sabhakto samāno pūve bhaktaṃ paścādbhaktaṃ vā kuleṣu cāritramāpadyeya santaṃ bhikṣumanāmantrayitvā anyatra samaye pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 81. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, being one who has received [a meal invitation], should visit families before or after the meal without informing an existing <s>bhikṣu</s> — except at the proper time — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: tatrāyam samayo cīvaradānakālasamayo ayamatrasamayo //
body.translated_text: Herein, the proper time is this: the time of robe-giving — this is the proper time herein.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.82. yo punabhikṣū rājñāḥ kṣatriyasya mūrdhā abhiṣiktasya janapadasthāmavīryaprāprasya antaḥpuraṃ praviśeyāniṣkrānte rājāne aniṣkrānte antaḥpure aniggate hi ratane hi antamasato indrakīlampi atikrameya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 82. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should enter the inner quarters of a king — a <s>kṣatriya</s> who has been anointed on the head, who has attained the power and might of the realm — when the king has not come out and the inner quarters have not been vacated, when the jewels have not been removed, even if he crosses so much as the threshold — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.83. yo punabhikṣū dantamayamvā asthimayamvā śṛṅgamayamvā suvaṇṇamayamvā rūpyamayamvā ratanamayamvā sūcīvigrahaṃ kārāpeya bhedana pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 83. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should have a needle case made of ivory, bone, horn, gold, silver, or jewels — it must be broken. It is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.84. mañcamvā pīṭhamvā bhikṣuṇā kārāpayamāṇena sugatāṣṭāṅgulapramāṇāḥ pādakāḥ kārāpayitavyāḥ / anyatrāṭṭanīye taduttariṃ kārāpeya cchedana pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 84. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a bed or a seat made, the legs should be made to the <s>Sugata</s>-measure of eight finger-breadths — not including the frame. If he has [them] made exceeding that — they must be cut down. It is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.85. yo punabhikṣū tūla saṃstṛte maṃce vā pīṭhe vā abhiniṣīdeya vā abhipadyeya vā uddāla na pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 85. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should sit down or lie down on a bed or seat stuffed with cotton — it must be pulled out. It is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.86. niṣīdanaṃ bhikṣuṇā kārāpayamāṇena prāmāṇikaṃ kārāpayitavyam / tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ dīrghaśo dve vitastīyo sugatavitastinā tiryag rddhamanyatra daśavitasti kaṃ taduttariṃ kārāpeya cchedana pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 86. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a sitting mat (<s>niṣīdana</s>) made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure for this is: two spans in length by the <s>Sugata</s>-span, one and a half in width, except for the border of ten spans. If he has [it] made exceeding that — it must be cut down. It is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.87. kanḍumapraticchādanaṃ bhikṣuṇā kārāpayamāṇena prāmāṇikaṃ kārāpayitavyaṃ / tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ dīrghaśo catvāri vitastīyo sugatavitastinā tiryagdve taduttariṃ kārāpeya cchedanapācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 87. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having an itch-covering cloth (<s>kaṇḍu-praticchādana</s>) made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure for this is: four spans in length by the <s>Sugata</s>-span, two in width. If he has [it] made exceeding that — it must be cut down. It is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.88. varṣāśāṣṭikā bhikṣuṇā kārāpayamāṇena prāmāṇikā kārāpayitavyā tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ dīrghaśo ṣaḍvitastīyo sugatavitastinā tiryag rddhatīyaṃ / taduttariṃ kārāpeya cchedana pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 88. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a rains-bathing cloth (<s>varṣāśāṭikā</s>) made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure for this is: six spans in length by the <s>Sugata</s>-span, two and a half in width. If he has [it] made exceeding that — it must be cut down. It is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.89. yo punabhikṣū sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ kārāpeya kiñcitasya bhagavate tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyak saṃbuddhasya sugatasya sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ dirghaśo nava vitastīyo sugatavitastinā tiryaka ṣaḍ idantasya bhagavato tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyak saṃbuddhasya sugatasya sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ tato vā punaruttariṃ kārāpeya cchedana pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 89. If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should have a robe made to the <s>Sugata</s>-robe measure — the <s>Sugata</s>-robe measure of the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the perfectly and fully awakened <s>Sugata</s> is nine spans in length by the <s>Sugata</s>-span and six in width — if he should have [a robe] made to this measure of the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the perfectly and fully awakened <s>Sugata</s>, or exceeding that — it must be cut down. It is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.90. yo punabhikṣū bhikṣūsya dusto doṣānkupito anāttano amulakena saṃghātiśeṣeṇa dharmmeṇānudhvaṃseya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 90. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, being corrupt, angry from hostility, displeased, should charge [a <s>bhikṣu</s>] with a baseless <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s> offense — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.91. yo punabhikṣū jānan sāṃdhikaṃ lābhaṃ saṃghe pariṇataṃ pudgalo pudgalasya pariṇāmeya pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 91. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should divert communal gains designated for the <s>Saṃgha</s> — one person diverting to another person — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pāc.92. yo punabhikṣūranvarddhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddiśyamāne evaṃ vadeya adya punarahaṃ jānāmi idānīṃ punarahaṃ jānāmi ayampi dharmo sūtrāgato sūtraparyāpanno anvarddhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśamāgacchati yāvadahannajānāmi tāvannāstīthaṃ makṣamāpattirjānea ca te bhikṣū taṃ bhikṣūm sakṛtdvitthikkhutto trikkhutto āgatapūrvvaṃ pi sannidhapūrvvaṃ pi kaḥ punarvvādo bahuśo nāsti kho punastasya bhikṣūsya ajñānena muktiḥ / atha iyāṃpi ca so bhikṣūrāpattimāpanno tu kṣiprameva yathādharmmaṃ yathāvinayaṃ kārāpayitavyo uttariṃ saṃmohamāpādayitavyo tasya te āyuṣman lābhādurlabdhāyastvaṃ anvarddhamāsaṃ sūtre pratimokṣo uddiśyamānenāsthīkṛtvā na manasi kṛtvā na sarvvacetasā samanvāhṛtya avahitaśroto sankṛtya dharmaśṛṇoṣīti imantasya bhikṣūsya sammohanayā pācattikam //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 92. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, when the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> sūtra is being recited every half-month, should speak thus: 'Only now do I know! Just now do I learn! This rule too is contained in the sūtra, included in the sūtra, and comes up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> sūtra every half-month — as long as I did not know, so long [I was pure].' There is no release on account of ignorance for that <s>bhikṣu</s>, if those <s>bhikṣus</s> know that <s>bhikṣu</s> has previously come once, twice, three times, or even more often, and has been present [at the recitation]. How much more [is there no release] for one who has attended many times! There is indeed no release through ignorance for that <s>bhikṣu</s>. Rather, whatever offense that <s>bhikṣu</s> has committed, he should be dealt with swiftly in accordance with <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>, and furthermore, confusion should be imposed upon him [saying]: 'It is your loss, venerable one, it is unfortunate for you, that when the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> sūtra is being recited every half-month, you do not take it seriously, do not attend to it, do not reflect on it with your whole mind, and do not listen to the <s>Dharma</s> with attentive ears.' The imposition of confusion on this <s>bhikṣu</s> is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: uddānam // [81] sabhakto [82] rājño [83] sūcīgṛhaṃ [84] mañca [85] tūla [86] niṣīdanaṃ [87] kanḍu [88] varṣāśāṣṭikā [89] sugatacīvara [90] mabhyākhyānaṃ [91] pariṇāmana [92] majñānakena // navamo vaggaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [81] one who has been invited, [82] king's [quarters], [83] needle case, [84] bed, [85] cotton, [86] sitting mat, [87] itch-cloth, [88] rains-bathing cloth, [89] <s>Sugata</s>-robe, [90] false accusation, [91] diverting [gains], [92] with [the plea of] ignorance. Ninth section.

body.text: vaggāṇāmuddānaṃ [1] mṛṣā [2] bījaṃ [3] asammato [4] ekāhaparamo [5] kṣobhi [6] saprāṇakaṃ [7] sañcintya [8] unaviṃśati [9] sabhaktakena // navamaḥ uddiṣṭāḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary of sections (<s>uddāna</s>): [1] lying, [2] seed, [3] unappointed, [4] one day at most, [5] agitation, [6] living beings, [7] deliberate, [8] under twenty, [9] with one who has been invited. The nine [sections] have been recited.

body.text: kho punarāyuṣmanto dvānavati śuddhapācattikā dharmmāstatrāyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhā dvitīyampi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ / tṛtīyampi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāttūṣṇīṃ mevametandhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the ninety-two pure <s>pācattika</s> rules [have been recited]. Therein I ask the venerable ones: 'Are you pure?' A second time I ask the venerable ones: 'Are you pure?' A third time I ask the venerable ones: 'Are you pure?' The venerable ones are pure herein, since they are silent — thus I understand it.

body.text: VI. THE FOUR PRATIDESANIYA DHARMAS.
body.translated_text: VI. THE FOUR <s>PRĀTIDEŚANĪYA</s> (RULES REQUIRING CONFESSION) RULES.

body.text: ime kho punarāyuṣmanto catvāraḥ pātideśanikā dharmā anvarddhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśamāgacchanti /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, these four <s>prātideśanīya</s> rules come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> sūtra every half-month.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pratid.1. yo punabhikṣu āraṇyake śayanāsane viharanto pūrvve apratisamveditaṃ vahidvā apratigṛhītamantevāsa vastusminnagilāno svahastaṃ khādanīyamvā bhojanīyamvā pratigṛhṇitvā khādeya vā bhuñjeya vā bhuktāvinā tena bhikṣuṇā pratideśayitavyaṃ / asaṃpreyamme āyuṣman gārhyamprātideśanikaṃ dharmmamāpanno taṃ dharmapratideśayāmi ayaṃ dharmmo prātideśaniko //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātideśanīya</s> 1. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, dwelling in a forest lodging, should accept with his own hand and eat hard or soft food that has not been previously announced or accepted in a place — [and he is] not ill — after eating, that <s>bhikṣu</s> should confess: 'Venerable one, I have committed a blameworthy, <s>prātideśanīya</s> offense. I confess that offense. This is a <s>prātideśanīya</s> rule.'

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pratid.2. yo punabhikṣuranyātikāye bhikṣuṇīye antaragṛhaṃ praviṣtāye agilāno svahastaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyamvā pratigṛhṇitvā khāde ya vā bhuñjeya vā bhuktā vinā tena bhikṣuṇā pratideśayitavyaṃ / asaṃpreyamme āyuṣman gārhyampratideśanikaṃ dharmmamāpanno taṃ dharmmaṃ pratideśayāmi / ayaṃ pi dharmmo prātideśaniko /
body.translated_text: <s>Prātideśanīya</s> 2. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, [being served by] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative, who has entered among the houses — [and he is] not ill — should accept with his own hand and eat hard or soft food, after eating, that <s>bhikṣu</s> should confess: 'Venerable one, I have committed a blameworthy, <s>prātideśanīya</s> offense. I confess that offense. This too is a <s>prātideśanīya</s> rule.'

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pratid.3. bhikṣu kho punarantaragṛhe nimantritakānmuñjanti tatra ca bhikṣuṇī viśvāsamānarūpāsthitā bhavati so evamāha iha odanaṃ dehi iha sūpaṃ dehi iha vyañjanaṃ dehīti vadeya sarvehi te bhikṣū hi sā bhikṣūṇī evamasya vacanīyā / āgamaya tāvattvaṃ bhagini yāvadbhikṣū bhuñjantīti ekabhikṣū pi ca tāṃ bhikṣuṇīnnevaṃ vadeya / āgamaya tāvattvaṃ bhagini yāvadbhikṣū bhuñjantīti bhuktāvīhi te hi bhikṣu hi pratideśayitavyaṃ / asaṃpreyamme āyuṣman gārhyampratideśanikaṃ dharmamāpanno taṃ dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi / ayampi dharmmo pratideśaniko //
body.translated_text: <s>Prātideśanīya</s> 3. When <s>bhikṣus</s> who have been invited are eating among the houses, and a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> stands [near them] in a position [suggesting] familiarity, and she says thus: 'Give rice here! Give soup here! Give condiments here!' — all those <s>bhikṣus</s> should address that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> thus: 'Wait, sister, until the <s>bhikṣus</s> have finished eating.' If not even one <s>bhikṣu</s> addresses that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> thus: 'Wait, sister, until the <s>bhikṣus</s> have finished eating' — after eating, those <s>bhikṣus</s> should confess: 'Venerable one, I have committed a blameworthy, <s>prātideśanīya</s> offense. I confess that offense. This too is a <s>prātideśanīya</s> rule.'

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā)_Pratid.4. yāni kho punarimāni śikṣasammatā ni kulāni bhavanti / tatra ca bhikṣūḥ pūrvve apravārito upasaṃkramitvā svahastaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā pratigṛhṇitvā khādeya vā bhuṃjeya vā bhuktāvinā tena bhikṣuṇā pratideśayitavyaṃ / asaṃpreyamme āyuṣman gārhyaṃ pratideśanikaṃ dharmamāpanno taṃ dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi / ayaṃ pi dharmo pratideśaniko //
body.translated_text: <s>Pratideśanika</s> 4. There are families considered to be in training (<s>śikṣasammata</s>). If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, not having been previously invited, should approach them and with his own hand accept and eat food, whether hard or soft — that <s>bhikṣu</s> should make confession, [saying]: 'Venerable one, I have committed a blameworthy matter — a <s>pratideśanika</s> (confessable) offense. I confess that offense.' This too is a <s>pratideśanika</s> rule.

body.text: uddānam // [1] āraṇyaka [2] mantaragṛhe [3] bhikṣū ca nimantritakāḥ [4] śaikṣasammatena catvāraḥ uddiṣṭāḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [1] forest-dweller, [2] in an inner room, [3] and <s>bhikṣu</s> who is [specifically] invited, [4] with families in training — four [rules] have been recited.

body.text: kho punarāyuṣmanto catvāraḥ prātideśanikā dharmāstatrāyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ / dvitīyampi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ tṛtīyampi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ pariśuddhāḥ atrāyuṣmanto yasmāttūṣṇīmevametaṃ dhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the four <s>pratideśanika</s> rules [have been recited]. Therein I ask the venerable ones: 'Are you pure?' A second time I ask the venerable ones: 'Are you pure?' A third time I ask the venerable ones: 'Are you pure?' The venerable ones are pure herein, since they are silent. Thus I understand it.

body.text: VII. THE SIXTY-SEVEN SAIKSA DHARMAS.
body.translated_text: VII. The sixty-seven <s>śaikṣa</s> (training) rules.

body.text: ime kho punarāyuṣmano sātireka pañcāṣaḍ śikṣādharmmā anvarddhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśamāga cchanti /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, these more than fifty-five <s>śaikṣa</s> rules come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> sūtra every half-month.

body.text:
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.1. parimaṇḍalannivasanaṃ nivāsayiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.2. parimaṇḍalaṃ cīvaraṃ prāvariṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.3. svasaṃvṛto antaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.4. na ukṣiptakṣūrantaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.5. alpaśabdo antaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.6. na ujhaggīkāya antaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.7. na oguṇṭhikāya antaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.8. na ukṣiptikāya antaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.9. na ukkuṭṭikāya antaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.10. na khambhakṛto antaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.11. na kāyapracālakamantaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.12. na śīrṣapracālakamantaragṛhamupasaṃ kramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.13. na bāhuvikṣepakamantaragṛhamupasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
body.translated_text:
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 1. 'I shall wear the inner robe evenly all around' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 2. 'I shall put on the outer robe evenly all around' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 3. 'I shall enter a household well-covered' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 4. 'I shall not enter a household with eyes raised' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 5. 'I shall enter a household with little noise' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 6. 'I shall not enter a household with loud laughter' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 7. 'I shall not enter a household with the head covered' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 8. 'I shall not enter a household with the robe hitched up' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 9. 'I shall not enter a household squatting' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 10. 'I shall not enter a household with arms akimbo' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 11. 'I shall not enter a household swaying the body' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 12. 'I shall not enter a household swaying the head' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 13. 'I shall not enter a household waving the arms' — thus should one train.

body.text: uddānam [1] nivasanaṃ [2] prāvaraṇaṃ [3] susaṃvṛto [4] cakṣūḥ [5] śabda [6] nojhaggīkā [7] na oguṇṭhikā [8] nokṣiptikā [9] na ukkuṭṭikā [10] na khambha [11] na kāya [12] na śīrṣa [13] na bāhukena / prathamo vaggaḥ /
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [1] inner robe, [2] outer robe, [3] well-covered, [4] eyes, [5] noise, [6] not with loud laughter, [7] not with head covered, [8] not hitched up, [9] not squatting, [10] not akimbo, [11] not body [swaying], [12] not head [swaying], [13] not with arms [waving]. First section.

body.text:
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.14. susaṃvṛto antaragṛhe niṣīdiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.15. na ukṣiptacakṣū antaragṛhe niṣīdiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.16. alpaśabdo antaragṛhe niṣīdiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.17. na ujhaggīkāya antaragṛhe niṣīdiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.18. na oguṇṭhikāya antaragṛhe niṣīdiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.19. na ukṣiptikāya antaragṛhe niṣīdiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.20. na osaktikāya antaragṛhe niṣīdiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.21. na pallatthikāya antaragṛhe niṣī diṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.22. na khambhakṛto antaragṛhe niṣīdiśyāmīti śi[kṣā] karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.23. na antaragṛhe niṣaṇṇo hastaṃ kokṛtyamvā pādakaukṛtyamvā kariṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
body.translated_text:
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 14. 'I shall sit in a household well-covered' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 15. 'I shall not sit in a household with eyes raised' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 16. 'I shall sit in a household with little noise' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 17. 'I shall not sit in a household with loud laughter' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 18. 'I shall not sit in a household with the head covered' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 19. 'I shall not sit in a household with the robe hitched up' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 20. 'I shall not sit in a household with the robe hanging down [off the shoulder]' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 21. 'I shall not sit in a household with legs crossed [loosely]' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 22. 'I shall not sit in a household with arms akimbo' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 23. 'I shall not fidget with the hands or feet while seated in a household' — thus should one train.

body.text: uddānaṃ // [14] susaṃvṛto [15] cakṣuḥ [16] śabda [17] nojhaggikā [18] na oguṇṭhikā [19] nokṣiptikā [20] nośaktikā [21] na pallatthikā [22] na khambha [23] na hastapādakaukṛtyena / dvitīyo vaggaḥ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>): [14] well-covered, [15] eyes, [16] noise, [17] not with loud laughter, [18] not with head covered, [19] not hitched up, [20] not hanging down, [21] not cross-legged, [22] not akimbo, [23] not fidgeting with hands and feet. Second section.

body.text:
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.24. satkṛtya piṇḍapātraṃ pratigṛhṇiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.25. samasūpaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuñjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.26. na stūpakārakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuñjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.27. nāvakīrṇṇakārakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.28. nāvagaṇḍakārakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.29. na jihvā nicārakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.30. nāti mahamte hi kavaḍe hi piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.31. nānāgatekavaḍe mukhadvāraṃ vivariṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.32. na kavaḍotkṣepakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.33. na kavaḍacchedakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.34. na sakavaḍena mukhena vāca bhāṣiṣyamīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /

body.text: uddānaṃ // [24] satkṛtya [25] samasūpa [26] na sūpa [27] nāvakīṇṇa [28] nāvaganḍa [29] na jihvā [30] nātimahāntaṃ [31] nānāgataṃ [32] na kavaḍotkṣepaka [33] na kavaḍacchedaka [34] na sakavaḍena mukhena vācaṃ // tṛtīyo vaggaḥ //

PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.39. na surusurukāraṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.40. na śuluśulukārakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.41. na hastanirddhūnakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuñjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.42. na sitthāvakārakaṃ piṇḍapātraṃ paribhuṃjiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /

PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.46. nadinnadinnāniṣṭhaṃ janāni odanena pracchādayiṣyāmi / bhūyo āgamanakarmatāmupādāyeti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.47. na sasithāmyānodakaṃ pṛthivyānniṣiñciṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.48. na saśitthena pāṇinā pānīyasthālakaṃ pratigṛhṇiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /

<s>Śaikṣa</s> 35. 'I shall not eat almsfood licking the bowl' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 36. 'I shall not eat almsfood licking the hands' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 37. 'I shall not eat almsfood licking the fingers' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 38. 'I shall not eat almsfood making smacking sounds' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 39. 'I shall not eat almsfood making slurping sounds' — thus should one train.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 40. 'I shall not eat almsfood making sipping sounds' — thus should one train.

PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.49. na thito niṣaṇṇasya agilānasya dharmmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.50. na niṣaṇṇo niṣadyasya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.51. na nīcāsane niṣaṇṇo uccāsane niṣaṇṇo agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.52. na upānahārūḍhasya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.53. na pādukārūḍhasya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /

body.translated_text: Training rule: "I will not teach <s>Dharma</s> while standing to one who is seated" — this is a <s>śaikṣa</s> (training rule) to be trained in. Training rule: "I will not teach <s>Dharma</s> from a lower seat to one seated on a higher seat" — this is a <s>śaikṣa</s> (training rule) to be trained in. Training rule: "I will not teach <s>Dharma</s> to one wearing sandals" — this is a <s>śaikṣa</s> (training rule) to be trained in. Training rule: "I will not teach <s>Dharma</s> to one wearing slippers" — this is a <s>śaikṣa</s> (training rule) to be trained in. Training rule: "I will not teach <s>Dharma</s> to one with a head-covering" — this is a <s>śaikṣa</s> (training rule) to be trained in. Training rule: "I will not teach <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not facing me" — this is a <s>śaikṣa</s> (training rule) to be trained in. Training rule: "I will not teach <s>Dharma</s> to one with a shawl draped over the shoulder" — this is a <s>śaikṣa</s> (training rule) to be trained in. Training rule: "I will not teach <s>Dharma</s> to one sitting cross-legged with arms clasping the knees" — this is a <s>śaikṣa</s> (training rule) to be trained in.

body.text: uddānam // [49] na thito [50] na niṣaṇṇo [51] uccāsana [52] upānaha [53] pādukā [54] oguṇṭhikā [55] na sanmukha [56] na osattikā [57] na pallatthikāya / pañcamo vagaḥ /
body.translated_text: Summary verse: [49] not standing, [50] not seated, [51] higher seat, [52] sandals, [53] slippers, [54] head-covering, [55] not facing, [56] not with shawl draped, [57] not with arms clasping knees — the fifth section.

body.text:
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.58. na śastrapāṇasya agilānasya dharmadeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.59. nāyudhapāṇisya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.60. na daṇḍapāṇisya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.61. na chatrapāṇisya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.62. na utpathena gacchanto pathena gacchantasya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.63. na pṛṣṭhato gacchanto purato gacchantasya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā)_Śai.64. na pādena gacchanto yānena gacchantasya agilānasya dharmandeśayiṣyāmīti śikṣākaraṇīyā /
